mood: Calm, inviting, tactile, encouraging, natural, non-stimulating

surface_strategy.name: The Wooden Block
surface_strategy.description: Elements should look like painted matte wooden blocks. No shiny gradients. Flat pastel background, chunky bottom shadow for 3D depth, and soft white inner top-highlight.

animations.entrance: Staggered spring animations (framer-motion). Type: 'spring', stiffness: 200, damping: 20.
animations.interactions: Scale down and shadow reduction on click to mimic physically pushing a wooden block down.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Large sizes (size={64} or size={80}), thick stroke (strokeWidth={3}), rounded edges. Avoid sharp geometric icons.

images.description: Abstract calm creamy background with soft sage water-color texture. Use as a fixed full-screen background z-[-1] with opacity-60.

component_guidelines.activity_cards: Bento grid structure. Each card must be massive (min 200px height), single icon, large text, utilizing one of the specific pastel block styles (e.g., card_sage, card_coral).
component_guidelines.buttons: Do not use standard Shadcn buttons for the toddler interface. Build custom 'wooden block' buttons using the surface_strategy classes. Standard Shadcn buttons can be used ONLY in the Parent Dashboard.
component_guidelines.navigation: Extremely simple. Always provide a massive 'Home' or 'Back' button (min 80x80px) in the top left during activities.
component_guidelines.audio: Integrate Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis) to speak the names of letters, numbers, animals, and colors when tapped. No background music unless in the nursery rhyme section.
component_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='activity-card-alphabet', data-testid='back-to-home-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: Fredoka and Nunito via Google Fonts.
Ensure the app is a Single Page Application (SPA). Keep all 6 activities easily reachable from the home grid.
Implement the 'Wooden Block' CSS exactly as specified in surface_strategy to achieve the tactile Montessori feel.
Avoid typical high-stimulation UI elements like fast spinners, intense gradients, or confetti. Use gentle spring physics and soft audio feedback.
For the Parent Dashboard, include a simple hidden entry point (e.g., holding a gear icon for 3 seconds, or a hidden corner tap) to prevent toddlers from accidentally entering it.
Parent Dashboard must use local storage to track which activities were opened and click counts to simulate 'time spent'.
Always use the provided generated images for the animal sound activity and backgrounds.
